author: Arnav
problem: Read N, K and a sequence A of N non-negative integers. Choose K of its elements; print the largest possible MEX of the chosen ones (the smallest non-negative integer not among them).
bug_description: Compares p with the loop index i instead of the value a[i], which is always true, so it prints the number of distinct values capped at K.

comments.accurate: Walks the sorted distinct values up from 0 and stops at the first gap or after K values
comments.wrong_behavior: Takes the MEX as the number of distinct values, capped at K
comments.wrong_location: Gap check verified; check duplicates are removed before sorting
